verdict.rationale: Jeeves docs mention customizable roles & permissions (jeeves-docs-22, jeeves-docs-37), employee permissions with audit trails (jeeves-docs-29), and automated invoice payment/approval flows (jeeves-docs-27), indicating some approval-permission infrastructure exists. However, there is no explicit description of a one-click approve-and-send action for designated teammates or how approval roles are configured in practice. Missing for 10: explicit one-click approval UI/workflow documentation, detail on assigning approver roles specifically for payments, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the approval flow.
